facts.text: Lunch first, then I will go punch something out of the sky. Even I need a feed.
facts.why: Carol never says this. The quote page lists her real lines. It is printed in quote marks as her words. Her real motto is 'Higher, further, faster, baby.'

vibe.verdict: The ship's ration sheet looks good, but a Louisiana kitchen and 1995 video store should feel warmer than a spaceship form.
